jobs.occupation: Warehouse job: order picker in day shift
jobs.description:
Are you already familiar with orderpicking and logistics? And are you looking for a stable and physically engaging role with job security? And do you like great hours to get a good work-life balance? Then this is an excellent opportunity for you!

For a large and growing logistics in Oostkamp specialised in frozen goods, we're looking for an orderpicker to join the day shift team in the freezer warehouse. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an orderpicker, you play a crucial part in the company’s logistical process. You work in the freezer every day to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

• Making orders based on order lists

• Preparing completed orders for shipment

• Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks

You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work

• Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment

• Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)

Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

jobs.occupation: Order picker - night shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in order picking or logistics? Are you looking for a physically challenging role with job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a stable and growing transport company in Oostkamp that specializes in frozen food logistics, we're looking for an order picker to join the team in the freezer in the night shift. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an order picker, you're the corner stone of the company's logistical processes. You work in the freezer every night to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

• Making orders based on order lists

• Preparing completed orders for shipment

• Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks

You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work

• Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment

• Feel at your absolute best at night and are looking for a night job

• Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)

Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

Team/division description
 

Material Engineering division widely contributes to Toyota development activities from vehicle development projects to fundamental research. Our team is committed to develop solutions and to introduce attractive & environment-friendly materials towards circular economy, carbon neutrality and customer happiness.
 

Your responsibilities
 

 
• Prepare Purchase Orders, and proceed receiving and invoicing 
 
• Process technical reports towards official issuance acc. to our internal process 
 
• Prepare and format documents, reports, presentations
 
• Establish guidelines and procedures 
 
• Actively propose and implement cost reduction and efficiency ideas 
 
• Support the team’s digitalization processes 
 
• Manage calendars, schedule meetings, and coordinate appointments. 
 
• Support internal and external communication with stakeholders. 
 
• Assist in organizing events, workshops, and team activities.  

Your profile
 

 
• Proven experience as administrative assistant 
 
• Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
 
• Rigorous and self-disciplined
 
• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Flemish and French are a plus.
 
• A very good knowledge of Excel is required (advanced formulas, pivot table...), and powerBI. A good command of powerApp is a plus.
 
• Discretion and confidentiality in handling sensitive information.
 
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
 
• You have a Toyota DNA, this means: 
 

Courage: you are ready to let go of the easy path to reach challenging targets Collaboration: you are a team player, respectful and inclusive in your style and you take a customer-oriented approach
 

Creativity: your passion drives you to explore innovative ideas and challenge the impossible
 

Curiosity: you combine imagination and fact-based observation
 

Coaching: you share knowledge and feedback with your colleagues and celebrate each other’s success

jobs.occupation: Multi-skilled maintenance technician - English is allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on technician who's already living in Belgium? Do you have solid knowledge of electricity or electromechanics? And are you looking for a stable job in maintenance work with lots of variety? Then this might be the job for you!

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician with a strong background in electrical maintenance or electromechanics to help maintain the buildings, warehouse, technical installations, and outdoor areas of the company. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you play a key role in ensuring the reliability, safety, and operational performance of the infrastructure. You perform both the preventive and corrective maintenance of all the facilities, ensuring the logistical operations keep running safely and efficiently. Electricity is at the heart of the job, but you're also responsible for a wide range of general building maintenance.

Your key duties:

• Perform various kinds of repairs, replacements and maintenance works to the infrastructure of the company

• Carry out preventive technical controls on the various installations

• Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities

• Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles

• Supervise external contractors and service providers

You'll sometimes need to go into the freezer warehouse, of course with the necessary thermal clothing.

Is this you?

• Education and/or experience in electrical maintenance, electromechanics or another relevent technical field

• Able to read electrical diagrams and schematics

• Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)

• Very good knowledge of English, both spoken and written

• Already living in Belgium, preferably in the greater area of Oostkamp

Then please don't hesitate to apply, because this job could be yours!

Any other technical skills are a big plus but not required, e.g. mechanics, plumbing, HVAC...

As a warehouse worker in Wevelgem, you will be involved in the entire logistics process, from receiving to shipping goods. Every day, you use an electric pallet truck, forklift, and handheld scanner. You make sure everything is stored properly, orders are ready on time, and the warehouse stays tidy.
Your day starts between 7 and 8 AM, depending on your training. You pick orders, load and unload trucks and containers, and handle the administrative tasks related to shipments. For this, you use a PC, printer, and ERP system. You carry out simple visual checks and make sure everything runs safely and according to company guidelines. You actively participate in the daily team meeting with your colleagues and support each other.
Ready to roll up your sleeves and feel at home in a warehouse? Apply quickly and make a difference in a growing company!

You speak and write fluent Dutch (preferably), and/or English and/or French.You have a certificate for electric pallet truck and forklift.Experience in a warehouse environment is a plus.You work accurately and with a focus on quality.You are flexible and have a hands-on attitude.You enjoy working in a team and communicate respectfully.You actively participate in the daily team meeting.

Conforma is a Contract Manufacturing Organisation (CMO) specialising in the manufacturing of non-sterile liquid and semi-solid pharmaceutical and medical device products, including solutions, syrups, gels and creams.
 

As we expand internationally, we are looking for an Outbound Sales professional to identify new opportunities, build a qualified prospect pipeline and support our commercial visibility.
 

This is a 
 hands-on commercial role 
combining market research, lead generation, outbound sales and business development. You will identify companies whose products could potentially be manufactured by Conforma, assess whether they have internal manufacturing capabilities, and identify the right people to approach.
 

You will help us turn market intelligence into concrete commercial opportunities.
 

Your responsibilities
 

· Identify and map potential customers across Europe and, subsequently, international markets
 

· Research companies, product portfolios and manufacturing capabilities to identify potential outsourcing and contract manufacturing opportunities
 

· Build and maintain a structured, high-quality prospect database and prioritise opportunities based on commercial potential
 

· Identify relevant decision-makers and map professional contact details
 

· Use online research, professional networks, databases and direct telephone contact to obtain or verify information and establish the right point of contact
 

· Support targeted outbound campaigns and follow up qualified leads together with the Business Development team
 

· Support the organisation and commercial follow-up of relevant international trade fairs and industry events
 

· Help keep Conforma's LinkedIn company page professional, current and engaging by contributing to relevant posts and content

We are looking for someone who is curious, commercially minded, proactive and not afraid to pick up the phone. You enjoy investigating companies, finding information that is not immediately available and turning that information into actionable opportunities.
 

· A higher education degree or equivalent experience in business, marketing, life sciences, pharmaceutical sciences, international business or a related field
 

· Excellent written and spoken Dutch & English is essential
 

· Strong research, analytical and organisational skills
 

· Excellent communication skills and the confidence to speak with people you have never contacted before
 

· A commercial mindset and genuine interest in business development
 

· Persistence and the ability to professionally obtain information
 

· Good digital and online research skills
 

· The ability to work independently while collaborating closely with the Business Development team
 

What makes this role different?
 

This is not a traditional telesales position. You will not simply work through a predefined list of leads. You will help build our international market map from the ground up: identifying potential customers, understanding their products and manufacturing footprint, discovering where outsourcing opportunities may exist and determining who we should speak to.
 

Your work will directly contribute to Conforma's international growth and give you the opportunity to build a broad network within the pharmaceutical and medical device industries.

As a cleanroom assistant you play a crucial role in the production process of advanced cell therapies. After extensive training in aseptic and GMP-compliant work, you and your colleagues will contribute to daily production activities following strict standard procedures.

As a cleanroom assistant you will be the person who ensures that day-to-day operations run smoothly and trouble-free within the cleanroom environment

• Supporting the aseptic and manual production process.

• Checking, maintaining, and cleaning equipment and materials.

• Ensuring proper transfer between different production zones.

• Adhering to established quality and safety standards to guarantee timely therapies for patients.

• A strong sense of responsibility and passion for healthcare.

• Strong communication skills and a team-oriented mindset.

• Accuracy and willingness to work in an aseptic environment with sterile clothing.

• An A2 diploma or equivalent experience – full training is provided.

• Willingness to work in several shifts (early,late, nights) and on weekends.

• You have your own transport, depending on the distance this can be with a car, electric bike,.. (because of the shifts you can not rely on public transport)

• Good knowledge of English.

Start your career in Pharma in a Lab Support role!
 

Are you ready to make a real impact in the world of biotechnology? 
 

 
 

Are you detail-oriented and comfortable working in a rapid changing, clean environment with very strict procedures? Do you want to contribute to the production of innovative, life-saving cell therapies? Then this could be the opportunity for you.
 

After extensive training in aseptic working and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), you’ll join our Operations Team and support the production of the Carvykti treatment in a highly controlled cleanroom environment.
 

What You’ll Do
 

 
• Support the daily aseptic and manual production process, following strict procedures and quality standards.
 
• Prepare workstations, equipment, tools and materials for production.
 
• Clean and disinfect materials and equipment to maintain a sterile environment.
 
• Inspect equipment and ensure the correct transfer of materials between production zones.
 
• Work closely with operators and team leads to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality therapies to patients. 
 

Good to Know You’ll work in a sterile environment wearing protective clothing. This role follows a shift schedule including weekends, but no night shifts. Full training is provided.

We are looking for you if:
 

 
• You live near Gent/Zwijnaarde or have reliable transportation such as bike or Car.
 
• Fluent in English, you thrive in teamwork and are eager to learn new skills.
 
• You are accountable and motivated to make a difference in patient's lives. 
 
• Your attention to detail is unmatched.
 
• Bonus points for familiarity with GMP standards, aseptic techniques, sterilization methods, and MS Office.

jobs.occupation: Finance, HR and office assistant M/W/X
jobs.employer_name: FEDERATION INTERNATIONALE DES MOUVEMENTS D'AGRICULTURE  BIOLOGIQUE-GROUPE REGIONAL EUROPEEN
jobs.description:
Finance Administration: 

• Assist in financial administration: this involves maintaining accurate document management of financial transactions, including invoices, receipts, and bank statements. The assistant may also be responsible for filing and organizing these records. 
• Prepare and send sponsorships/memberships/donations invoices. 
• Process invoices, reimbursements, and payments, including petty cash and bank card management. Ensure all the proofs of payment are compliant with internal rules. 
• Process travel reimbursement forms and follow up with employees to ensure compliance with internal rules. 
• Secure all necessary documents are accurately completed and submitted on time for month-end and quarterly financial closing. 
• Reconcile bank and credit card transactions, ensuring that all transactions are supported by the required documents. 
• Assist with audits, providing documentation as needed. 
• Create and update finance spreadsheets, data entry. 
• Copy, scan, email, organize, and archive finance documents. 
• Train staff on necessary financial procedures. 
• Liaise with external providers for all administrative and accountable documents if needed. 
• Liaise with staff members regarding invoices, travel reimbursements, finance administrative documents, and information when needed. 
Human Resources: 

• Assist in defining and implementing the annual staff Training Plan by ensuring contacts with internal and external providers, coordinating schedules, and handling all administrative and logistical aspects of training sessions. 
• Act as the primary point of contact for employee HR inquiries, effectively screening and prioritizing requests, providing preliminary guidance, and routing complex issues to the appropriate FLOEE colleagues. 
• Support the integration of HR procedures with finance procedures. Ensure seamless communication and information flow across all HR-related matters between staff, managers, and the FLOEE colleagues. Monitor and support the correct application and adherence to internal HR policies and procedures. 
• Maintain and update employee records and HR databases. 
• Assist in recruitment, onboarding, offboarding and training of new employees and trainees. 
• Assist with employee benefits and leave policies. 
• Assist in organizing staff's yearly excursion.
Office Coordination: 

• Direct internal and external calls, emails, and post mail to designated units 
• Monitor office supplies and equipment and order replacements (stationary, coffee, tea, etc.) 
• Being the person of contact for the service providers (phone, cleaning services, building, handyman, etc.) 
• Participate in improving office environment (plants, work-friendly spaces, etc) 
• Ensure the office is clean, and the employees respect the office rules (kitchen, sanitary) 
• Schedule and organising documents for staff weekly, monthly, and quarterly meetings 
• Being the person of contact for the IT Consultant 
• Liaise with staff members regarding hardware (problems encountered, requests for equipment, etc.,) 
• Monitor IT equipment (list of equipment, storage, depreciation list) 
• Prepare workstations for new staff 
• Follow up with the phone system (user access and account) ¿ Support staff members with workstation equipment. 
• After the necessary training is provided, being a responsible person for security and prevention in the office (e.g. fire prevention) 
• Make travel arrangements including flights, accommodation, and ground transportation 
The Assistant will organize and support the office's day-to-day finance and employee's administration. They will ensure effectiveness and compliance with internal procedures and maintain the quality of data management. The Assistant plays a crucial role in ensuring that office operations run smoothly and accurately and that our records are maintained in compliance with internal procedures.

Education & Qualifications 

• Bachelor's degree in administration, accounting, HR related fields (or equivalent) 
Experience - Essential 

• Knowledge of MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) 
• Effective communication skills in English including verbal and written skills 
• Understanding of office routine 
• Knowledge of French 
Experience - Desirable 

• Proven work experience as administrative assistant or similar role is an asset 
• Knowledge about/work experience in Non-Governmental-Organisations 
• Knowledge about/work experience in the EU institutions 
• Knowledge of Italian
Skills & Attributes 

• Excellent time management and organizational skills 
• Excellent administration skills 
• High attention to detail 
• Strong problem solving and communication skills 
• Only EU citizens or non-EU nationals with a valid Belgian working permit can apply 
• Full-time position - Monday to Friday, 38 hours/week 
• Based at the IFOAM Organics Europe office in Brussels 
• Salary between 2.200 and 2.500 gross monthly depending on qualifications and experience 
• Employment period: determined contract of 8 months with a tentative starting date as November 1 st , renewable 
• High level of flexibility with floating hours and possibility of home working 
• Home working allowance on daily basis 
• Working from abroad (max 1 month per civil year) after approval from the manager 
• Public transport coverage from home to the office or bike km 
• Hospitalisation and health insurance plan A-Z from DKV 
• Meal voucher (€8/ working day with €1.09 at charge of the employee) 
• €250 eco-cheque/year (prorate of the number of months worked) 
• Holidays payment (92% of the salary in June if applicable) 
• 24 days holiday per year 
• Extra holiday: Christmas Break from 24 December to 31 December and the Friday after Assumption

As a Truck Adaptation Engineer, you will be responsible for designing and developing technical solutions for customers requiring specific modifications to their vehicles.

• Translate customer requirements into technically feasible concepts.
• Design and document non-standard solutions to ensure successful assembly within the production facility.
• Advise internal stakeholders on technical possibilities and solutions.
• Collaborate closely with various departments across the organization.
• Take ownership of technical decisions and assume end responsibility for your engineering concepts.
• Contribute to innovative and sustainable transport solutions.

For our client, Volvo Trucks Ghent, the largest truck manufacturing plant within the Volvo Group, we are looking for a Truck Adaptation Engineer. From its Ghent site, nearly 3,000 employees work every day to produce high-quality trucks. Innovation, sustainability, quality and continuous improvement are at the heart of this international manufacturing environment. You will join a team of engineers responsible for developing customer-specific truck adaptations and delivering tailored technical solutions.

 

As a Truck Adaptation Engineer, you will be responsible for designing and developing technical solutions for customers requiring specific modifications to their vehicles.

• Translate customer requirements into technically feasible concepts.
• Design and document non-standard solutions to ensure successful assembly within the production facility.
• Advise internal stakeholders on technical possibilities and solutions.
• Collaborate closely with various departments across the organization.
• Take ownership of technical decisions and assume end responsibility for your engineering concepts.
• Contribute to innovative and sustainable transport solutions.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering or equivalent through experience.
• A strong interest in automotive engineering and vehicle technology.
• Previous experience is not required; recent graduates are encouraged to apply.
• Knowledge of trucks is considered a strong asset.
• Accurate, structured and capable of working independently.
• A strong team player with excellent collaboration skills.
• Good knowledge of MS Office.
• Able to read and interpret technical drawings.
• Excellent command of Dutch and English.

Some people wait for opportunities.

Others create them.

We're looking for a Business Manager who thrives on opening new doors, building powerful client relationships, and turning business challenges into consulting solutions.

Client Details

Our client is a well-established Belgian consulting company with more than 15 years of success and a strong reputation in technology consulting. Over the last few years, the company has made a strategic shift towards one of the fastest-growing markets: Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Machine Learning and AI Leadership.

Today, their challenge isn't finding talent.

It's finding enough clients for the exceptional consultants already in the business.

That's where you come in.

Description

You will be responsible for developing new business opportunities and growing a portfolio of clients across Brussels and Belgium.

From first contact to long-term partnership, you'll own the entire sales cycle.

You will:

• Identify and approach new clients
• Build relationships with decision-makers and executives
• Understand business challenges and propose the right consulting solution
• Sell AI expertise
• Negotiate commercial agreements and close deals
• Work closely with recruiters to match the right consultants to client needs
• Follow consultants on-site and ensure long-term client satisfaction
• Continuously expand your network and market knowledge
 

• You know how staffing and consulting work.
• You've already sold projects, consultants, services or expertise.
• You enjoy hunting for opportunities and building lasting commercial relationships.
• You probably have: 
• 2 to 6 years of experience in consulting, staffing, recruitment or IT services
• Experience developing new accounts from scratch
• A strong commercial mindset and entrepreneurial spirit
• The ability to challenge, influence and convince stakeholders
• Fluency in English, French and/or Dutch
• A passion for business development and people
• Most importantly: 
• You don't wait for leads.
• You create them.

Life Sciences

Description

As a Printing Assistant your responsibilities are:

• Archive, classify, and convert paper files into digital records
• Perform quality checks on documents

A successful Printing Assistant should have:

As an Account Manager, you will be responsible for growing the company's presence in Belgium by identifying opportunities, managing client portfolios, and driving commercial success.

Client Details

Join an innovative and fast-growing technology company that helps organizations optimize their digital document and information management processes. With a strong reputation in its sector and a customer-centric approach, the company continues to expand its presence across the Belgian market.

Description

• Develop and expand the Belgian market through active business development.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients.
• Identify client needs and propose tailored solutions.
• Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting to contract negotiation.
• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure excellent customer satisfaction.
• Monitor market trends and identify new growth opportunities.
• Represent the company during client meetings and networking events.

• Proven experience in a B2B Account Management or Business Development role.
• Fluent in French OR Dutch, with a good command of English.
• Strong commercial mindset and excellent negotiation skills.
• Autonomous, proactive, and results-driven.
• Comfortable developing a market and creating business opportunities.
• Experience within technology, software, SaaS, services, or solutions sales is a strong advantage.
